How to get it :
- Crafting table : 2 x Steel Plate, Gold Plate, 3 x Steel Scaffold, 3 x [[gv:steel_beam|Steel Beam]].

Used to make :
[[gv:mp_fuselage_15_20_kerosene|Size 15/20 Kerosene Fuselage]], [[gv:mp_fuselage_15_20_solid|Size 15/20 Solid Fuel Fuselage]], [[gv:mp_thruster_20_kerosene|Size 20 Liquid Fuel Thruster]], [[gv:mp_thruster_20_kerosene_dual|Size 20 Liquid Fuel Twin Thrusters]], [[gv:mp_thruster_20_kerosene_triple|Size 20 Liquid Fuel Triple Thrusters]], [[gv:mp_thruster_20_solid|Size 20 Solid Fuel Thruster]], [[gv:mp_thruster_20_solid_multi|Size 20 Solid Fuel 30-Fold Thrusters]], [[gv:mp_thruster_20_solid_multier|Size 20 Solid Fuel 47-Fold Thrusters]].
